dispositionRule: A FAIL is never auto-converted to PASS. Each finding is classified across five axes: (a) blocker? (b) documented exception? (c) accepted remediation path? (d) who owns acceptance? (e) extra security review required? Describing a failure as 'intentional' is NOT a disposition.

findings.title: cast.exe outside configured trust roots
findings.remediationPath: V06-Path-2 only: install trusted cast inside an approved trust root, verify source/version/hash OUTSIDE the tool itself, rerun V06+V07, independent review of the trust path. Moving the file alone is insufficient (SPEC §8).

findings.remediationPath: Code fix in next release (v4.2.2): emit final summary line before script exit (Write-Progress hoisting).

findings.title: Legacy scripts contain --private-key / cast send patterns
